summary: Full backend + frontend regression for corporate AK Parti inspired redesign (orange/yellow/navy + Bebas Neue + left slide-out drawer). Backend 22/22 pytest cases pass. Frontend left drawer slides in correctly on all 7 public pages, corporate typography and colors verified, hero countdown & stats render, admin panel (8 pages) loads in white/light theme with new orange accents, and both registration forms (/uyelik, /zirve-kaydi) submit successfully.

minor.issue: Still returns success-like 200 when SENDGRID_API_KEY is unset (sendgrid_configured flag now present as requested). Carried-over cosmetic from iter 2.

issues: Top 3px gradient accent bar confirmed: linear-gradient(90deg, #F39200 0%, #FFCD00 50%, #F39200 100%).
Primary CTA (nav-register-btn) uses orange→yellow gradient linear-gradient(135deg, #F39200 0%, #FFCD00 100%) with white text - matches spec.
Hero headline 'ARSA YATIRIM ZİRVESİ 2026' renders in Bebas Neue (font-family: 'Bebas Neue', Oswald, sans-serif; letter-spacing 3.84px) - condensed display font confirmed.
Drawer panel slides in from LEFT (getBoundingClientRect left≈0, width=448, 85% viewport). Backdrop appears, body scroll locks.

Drawer contents verified visually: logo AYZ, MENÜ section (ANA SAYFA, KONUŞMACILAR, PROGRAM, ETKİNLİKLER, BLOG), KAYIT section (ÜCRETSİZ ÜYELİK, ZİRVE KAYDI), İLETİŞİM info (date, venue, email), and orange 'ÜCRETSİZ ÜYE OL' CTA at footer.
Close button and backdrop both close drawer. Drawer opens successfully from all 7 public pages (/, /konusmacilar, /program, /etkinlikler, /blog, /uyelik, /zirve-kaydi).
Split grid layout rendered: navy hero text on left, light/white countdown card on right.
Countdown card shows GÜN/SAAT/DK/SN values (e.g., 26/16/17/26) and stats contain KONUŞMACI, OTURUM, KATILIMCI tokens.
All 8 admin pages (/admin/dashboard, /members, /guests, /speakers, /blog, /banners, /events, /program) load with body bg rgb(255,255,255) and non-empty content.
Sidebar active item uses new orange accent (screenshot of /admin/program shows orange left-border + orange text on active 'Program' item + orange 'YENI OTURUM' CTA).

action_items: No blocking issues found this iteration. Optional: clean up TEST_ prefixed seed data accumulated in members/guests collections across iterations.

No rate limiting on /api/auth/login - add slowapi or similar (carried).
Console logs show benign 401s from /api/auth/me on unauthenticated pages - consider handling 401 silently in auth bootstrap to keep console clean.
